uncited: Topology and Ambiguity Handling addresses the topological inconsistencies that arise in standard Marching Cubes when processing ambiguous voxel configurations (cases 46, 47, 98, 99, 210, 213, 214, 215) .

These cases contain saddle points where the isosurface passes through the cube center, and the standard Lookup Table uses a fixed triangulation that can cause cracks or holes if adjacent voxels resolve the ambiguity differently .
The standard 256-case lookup table, while efficient, does not account for the topological consistency required for a manifold mesh when saddle points are present .
